title: Your first trade for Thursday, March 15
text: Your first trade for Thursday, March 15 Nia Warfield The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open. Pete Najarian was a buyer of IBM IBM . Tim Seymour was a buyer of JPMorgan JPM . Karen Finerman was a buyer of Lowe's LOW . Guy Adami was a buyer of Tenet Healthcare THC .
